authoredNote: Expectations written from the lane's own dedupe rule (`type|source|target`, one row per triple) and from the ordering of `analyze` — the script delegate merge (step 3b) precedes the template read pass (step 3c) — then read off the post-fix run and checked against the fixture's text: `$: doubled = count * 2` on line 26, `{count}` on 29, `{doubled}` on 30, `{onlyTemplate}` on 31.
rationale: JOB 2 of the svelte ontology pass, and the measured shape of the DERIVATION finding this lane carries. The dedupe kept the FIRST row for a triple and the delegate's rows are pushed first, so a template read of a member the script also read was dropped with nothing recorded. 384 of 5,781 template reads (6.6%) on the 3,085 corpus files where an independent oracle's shadow model is provably equivalent to this analyzer's. The graph contract — one edge per (type, source, target) — is NOT changed: `count` still publishes exactly one `uses`, at the script's line and the script's confidence. What is new is that the dropped template site is visible: `templateReadLines: [29]` and `isTemplateRead: true`. The forbids pin the two halves of that decision: no SECOND `uses` row for the same pair (which would be the fabrication this lane has fixed twice), and no relabelling of the surviving row's line or confidence (which would move a field the shared payload budget and differential baseline own). `onlyTemplate` is the control — a template-only read must still get its own 0.95 `isTemplateExpression` row.

expectRelationships.comment: re-spelled 2026-10-20: the analyzer publishes this site list under `templateReadSites` (the same sites, the same order); only the KEY changed. Measured against ASTEngine.parseFile — the pinned line and every other pinned field already matched.

forbidRelationships.comment: the template read must NOT become a SECOND row for a triple the delegate already published: one edge per (type, source, target) is the lane's graph contract, and two rows would double-count one fact

the surviving row's line stays the SCRIPT's line (26). Moving it to the template site would rewrite a payload field the shared payload budget and the differential baseline pin, so the template site is recorded as metadata instead
a member read ONLY in the template has no script twin; it must keep its own `isTemplateExpression` row and must not be marked as a recorded template site on some other row
